Message:
I’m...the happiest
I’ve ever been right now.

But, that’s all because
Mommy and Daddy saved me.

Whenever I think about them,
I start feeling sad...
But I have to keep
smiling for them.

“Do you really think
that’s what they’d want?”
Huh...?

“Maybe seeing you
genuinely smile,
with your whole heart,
was what made them happy.”

Am I not smiling now...?
With my whole heart...?

...! No, that doesn’t matter!
Because, I can smile!
I mean, I promised them,
so I have to...!

I have to try really hard
and smile, so they won’t
worry about me!

“Tell me, Shiloh.
What makes you smile?”
What makes me smile...?

Um... Whenever Mommy and
Daddy were laughing and smiling,
it made me happy, too...

So, I would also smile.
Before, I never had to do
something like try hard
and smile—

Oh... I think
I’m starting to get it.
It wasn’t because of
a promise or anything.

I smiled because...
I loved seeing the people
I cared about smile.

And that’s why
Mommy and Daddy did too—
they smiled because of me.

“It’s perfectly normal to
cry when you feel sad.
And after that,
you can smile with your
whole heart again.”

The truth is...
I’ve been holding
everything in this whole time...

I didn’t wanna say goodbye
to Mommy and Daddy...!
I didn’t wanna be left all alone...!

“Mommy... Daddy...
I miss you so much...!
I’m so lonely without you...!”

Gracie pulled me into
her arms as I cried and cried.
Just like a big sister would...
